name: Dangsin-eul Gidarineun Yeou
source: The protagonist meets a fox girl in a bamboo grove, but he has no memory of how or why he was there. However, the girl seemed to know him. After talking to her, pieces of memories begin to come back. So he embarks on a memorable journey with the fox-eared girl.
translation: 主角在竹林里遇见了狐女，但他不记得他是如何或为什么在那里的。不过，这个女孩似乎认识他。与她交谈后，一些记忆开始浮现。于是，他与狐耳少女踏上了一段难忘的旅程。
